summary.text: Emily Tseffos is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Rachael Cabral-Guevara.
An educator by career, she was the Democratic nominee for Wisconsin State Assembly District 56 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Emily Tseffos was born in Wisconsin and earned a bachelor's degree from Edgewood College, and her career experience includes working as an educator.

Tseffos won the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 56 on August 13, 2024, and lost the general election that November to incumbent Republican Dave Murphy, 35.2 percent to 64.7 percent.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 19 on August 11, 2026, with 15,296 votes.
